Posterior upright trunk retains a plain upper rib-cage envelope, one continuous bony vertebral-position line, two lower hipbone summaries, a central sacrum and a coccygeal continuation. Individual ribs and vertebrae are intentionally not counted. Hip/sacral junctions are redrawn as shared boundaries rather than overlapping slivers, and the coccygeal continuation is lengthened to remain a physical line marker. Original 2.4 mm column and 1.4 mm outlines remain.
